thread:
harper: @here heads-up — Jamal's birthday is next Tue (May 7). Thinking a small office + Zoom toast at 3pm. Who can make it? Also what snacks: cupcakes, empanadas, or fruit platter? 🎉
jamal: lol didn’t know y'all were conspiring. I will be there for cake (and the beers after). 😂
lia: cupcakes for me! can bring gluten-free options if needed.
people-ops-bot: Quick RSVP tracker: please react with :tada: if you can make it in-person, :computer: if you'll join via Zoom, or :wave: if you can't but want a virtual card. Also reply with snack preference.
noah: :tada: + cupcakes. I can bring a Bluetooth speaker for the Zoom audio.
sophia: :computer: fruit platter please. Zoom okay for me — will be in APAC morning but can pop in for the toast.
taylor: :tada: empanadas look amazing. happy to pick them up on my way in.
harper: awesome — tally so far: in-person = noah, taylor, harper; virtual = sophia, jamal? jamal said in-person though. :)
jamal: in-person for the win. also small request — no surprise serenade pls. :grimacing:
lia: noted. i'll bring GF cupcakes and labels. who wants candles?
noah: i'll grab candles + a lighter. also let's do a 3-minute agenda: quick kudos, toast, cake, back to ping-pong.
sophia: can someone post the Zoom link in #general the morning of? closest thing to a virtual party badge. :grin: 
harper: will post the Zoom link and calendar invite today. people-ops-bot, can you add Jamal's birthday card thread in Donut?
people-ops-bot: Card created: https://cards.internal/redwood/jamal-1991234567. Everyone can add a note until Mon 5pm.
taylor: perfect. thanks everyone! see you Tue. :tada:
